Disclaimer* Morgan Sindall Group PLC 16 November 2026 Morgan Sindall Group plc (“Morgan Sindall” or the “Company”) Transaction in Own Shares Morgan Sindall Group plc (“Morgan Sindall” or the “Company”) announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the “Buyback”) announced on 5 th November 2026, from 9 th November 2026 up to and including 13 th November 2026 the Company has purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 5 pence each (the “Ordinary Shares”) through Deutsche Bank AG, London branch (trading for these purposes as Deutsche Numis) (“Deutsche Numis”). Date of purchase Aggregate number of Ordinary Shares purchased Volume weighted average price paid per Ordinary Share (GBp) Highest price paid per Ordinary Share (GBp) Lowest price paid per Ordinary Share (GBp) Trading venue 09/11/26 9,000 4,383.6196 4,410.00 4,324.00 XLON 10/11/26 9,000 4,456.1467 4,476.00 4,432.00 XLON 11/11/26 8,000 4,428.3258 4,468.00 4,376.00 XLON 12/11/26 8,000 4,537.6595 4,570.00 4,476.00 XLON 13/11/26 8,000 4,518.2753 4,552.00 4,490.00 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Following settlement and cancellation of the above purchased Ordinary Shares, the Company's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 48,680,044 Ordinary Shares, representing 48,680,044 total voting rights in the Company.
